answer: The mechanism I find most convincing: quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. Each task randomly selects a small mesa of graders from long-lived accounts whose reputation and earnings are collateral; randomness comes from a walnut-hard commitment beacon so nobody can predict the draw. Fresh fake identities never get selected, so minting sybils buys nothing. To tilt an outcome an attacker must control a whole dune of aged, profitable accounts, and corrupting one grader costs its staked history.
